# Playbooks: Credentials and agent identities (`lpm-access`)

Load a section only when `lpm-access.md` tells you to.

## § flow-access-review

## Flow: access review
Load when: decision row 2 of SKILL.md (review keys, agent credentials, principals, provider keys, the GitHub token or specialists)

### Preconditions
1. Read-only: call no write tool in this flow. The 4 secret reads (`list_api_keys`, `list_workspace_mcp_agent_credentials`, `list_workspace_ai_credentials`, `get_workspace_repository_credential`) need a `full` or `custom` key.
2. `list_api_keys` shows only the caller's own keys; there is no workspace-wide key audit. Never ask for another user's keys.

### Steps
1. `list_api_keys`() → per key `name`, `keyPreview`, `accessProfile`, `status`, `lastUsedAt`; flag `accessProfile == "full"` and active keys with no `lastUsedAt`.
2. `list_workspace_mcp_agent_credentials`(workspaceId) → `status`, `expiresAt`; compare `expiresAt` with now (status stays `active` after expiry). `[]` does not prove that none exist.
3. `list_workspace_agent_principals`(workspaceId) → `specialistType`, `mode`, `status`, `accessProfile`.
4. `list_workspace_ai_credentials`(workspaceId) → `provider`, `label`, `updatedAt`.
5. `get_workspace_repository_credential`(workspaceId) → `status`, `revision`, `validatedAt`.
6. projectId given → `list_project_specialist_assignments`(projectId) → `status` per principal; `get_project_specialist_governance_summary`(projectId) → `effectiveAssignmentCount`, `reviewState`.
7. A -32003 on one read → report that part as "needs a full or custom key" and continue with the others; this overrides core rule 2 (no STOP) for reads in this review. Message "You do not have permission to manage or view credentials in this workspace." → report that part as "not owner or admin of this workspace" instead.
8. Profile question: name the job, then the smallest preset from see `lpm-access.refs.md` § api-key-profiles (`read-only` first); `roadmap-owner-*` → an `lpm_mcp_` credential (see `lpm-access.flows.md` § flow-agent-identities).
9. Recommend one corrective action per flag (revoke an unused key, narrow a `full` key, rotate an expiring credential).

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| the user asks to fix a flag | it is a write: SKILL.md §4 row for that write, with the owner's order |
| `reviewState == "agent-reviewed"` | report it as an agent review, never as a human approval |

### Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| the review | nothing (read-only) | every section above is reported or marked "needs a full or custom key" / "not owner or admin of this workspace" |

### Report fields
Scope, per area (API keys, agent credentials, principals, provider keys, GitHub token, specialists) the masked values and flags, one corrective action per flag, Pending, Next.


## § flow-agent-identities

## Flow: agent identities and specialist assignments
Load when: decision rows 6 and 7 of SKILL.md (agent principals, `lpm_mcp_` credentials, specialist assignments)

### Preconditions
1. Run SKILL.md P1 first: the owner's order is quoted. Row 6: the caller can manage the workspace (P1 step 3). Row 7: no pre-check; the server decides ("You do not have permission to manage this project" → STOP, ask the project owner or a workspace owner or admin).
2. IDs: principalId (= agentPrincipalId) from `list_workspace_agent_principals`(workspaceId) → row with `status == "active"`; credentialId from `list_workspace_mcp_agent_credentials`(workspaceId) → the `id` that no other row names as `predecessorId`; accountableUserId and accountableOwnerUserId from `list_workspace_members`(workspaceId) → the human `userId` the owner names, never an `agent:` id and never the caller by default.
3. Facts (pairs, immutable fields, lifecycle, the copilot tool list): see `lpm-access.refs.md` § agent-credentials.

### Steps
1. `list_workspace_agent_principals`(workspaceId) → an active principal for the same purpose → reuse its `id`, skip step 2.
2. Register: `create_workspace_agent_principal`(workspaceId, displayName, specialistType, mode, version, authorityRestrictions, accessProfile, allowedTools, accountableOwnerUserId) [O] → keep `id`. Timeout → re-list first.
   - Copilot: pairs `advisor` + `roadmap-owner-advisor`, `executor` + `roadmap-owner-operator`; `allowedTools` = the names the owner picks from the copilot tool list (see `lpm-access.refs.md` § agent-credentials); `accountableOwnerUserId` = the owner or admin the owner names (default: the workspace owner, `list_workspaces` → `ownerId`), shown in the §6 question.
   - Specialist: `allowedTools` = read tool names the owner gives, or omit; omit `accountableOwnerUserId`.
3. Edit or archive: `update_workspace_agent_principal`(workspaceId, agentPrincipalId, changed fields; arrays sent whole; status=`archived` only after the permanent question) [O].
4. Issue: principal must be `workspace-owner-copilot` and `active`. `create_workspace_mcp_agent_credential`(workspaceId, principalId, accountableOwnerUserId, accessProfile, allowedTools=<subset of the principal's>, name, expiresAt=<owner, at most 90 days ahead>) [O] → keep `id`, `maskedKey`; hand over `secret` once.
5. Rotate: `rotate_workspace_mcp_agent_credential`(workspaceId, credentialId, expiresAt=<at most 90 days>, overlapMinutes=<0–15, default 10>) [O] → hand over `secret` once; the old secret stops at `predecessor.overlapUntil`. Timeout → re-list: a row with `predecessorId` == credentialId exists → no second rotation.
6. Suspend, reactivate, revoke: `status` already the target → report "already <status>", no call; else `update_workspace_mcp_agent_credential_status`(workspaceId, credentialId, status) [O]; `revoked` is final (row 6 again for a new credential).
7. Specialist: the principal must have `specialistType != "workspace-owner-copilot"`, `status == "active"` and `mode` `advisor` or `reviewer`; else STOP (the server does not reject a copilot). `list_project_specialist_assignments`(projectId) → keep `id`, `status` of the row for the named principal; an active row → reuse it, no create. Pre-read `get_project_specialist_governance_summary`(projectId) → keep `effectiveAssignmentCount`.
8. Assign: `create_project_specialist_assignment`(projectId, agentPrincipalId, accountableUserId, scopeStatement, authorityBoundary) [O] → keep `id`. Add `validUntil`, `reviewCadence` only when the owner gave them; never invent a date or cadence. Not idempotent; no update exists: a change is revoke + create.
9. Unassign: `status == "revoked"` → report "already revoked", no call; else `revoke_project_specialist_assignment`(projectId, assignmentId=`id` from step 7) [O].
10. Verify: run the Verify table below.

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| before `create_workspace_mcp_agent_credential`, `rotate_workspace_mcp_agent_credential` | "Create/rotate <name>, profile <p>, expires <ISO date ≤ 90 days>? The secret is shown once." |
| before `update_workspace_mcp_agent_credential_status` (revoked), `update_workspace_agent_principal` (archived), `revoke_project_specialist_assignment` | "This is permanent: <the credential stops now / every credential of the principal stops / the assignment never returns>. Proceed?" |
| before `create_workspace_agent_principal`, `create_project_specialist_assignment` | show every field, including `accountableOwnerUserId` / `accountableUserId` and the `allowedTools` list; "Type, mode, version and profile never change; assignments have no update. Create?" |
| copilot `allowedTools` or the accountable user not named by the owner | ask; never fill them yourself |
| "Credential binding is no longer valid" / "scope is no longer valid" | principal archived or changed, or the owner lost admin → new principal or credential |
| a principal or assignment would get authority to approve scope, budgets or decisions | refuse; agents never get human governance authority |

### Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| principal create, edit, archive | `list_workspace_agent_principals`(workspaceId) | fields or `status` as requested |
| credential issue, rotate, status | `list_workspace_mcp_agent_credentials`(workspaceId) | new `id` with `status == "active"` and the given `expiresAt`, or the requested `status` |
| assignment create, revoke | `list_project_specialist_assignments`(projectId) | row `id` has the requested `status` |
| assignment create, revoke (report only) | `get_project_specialist_governance_summary`(projectId) | report `effectiveAssignmentCount` before → after; it moves only when the assignment is effective now (`validFrom` ≤ now < `validUntil`) |

### Report fields
Scope, owner order (quoted), principal `id`, credential `id` + `maskedKey` + `expiresAt` (never the secret), assignment `id` + `status`, Pending (agent config update before `overlapUntil`), Next.


## § flow-workspace-secrets

## Flow: workspace secrets (AI provider key, GitHub token)
Load when: decision row 8 of SKILL.md (set, replace or remove an AI provider key or the workspace GitHub token)

### Preconditions
1. Run SKILL.md P1 first: the owner's order is quoted and the caller can manage the workspace.
2. The agent never reads a secret value. AI key: the owner types it in the LPM web UI, "Configurações → Integrações → Credenciais de IA por workspace". GitHub token: the CLI reads it from an env var the owner names (`<ENV_NAME>`); ask for the NAME, never the value; never print, log or commit it.
3. The MCP upserts put the secret into a tool argument, so it passes through the agent's context and transcript: use them only after the owner accepts that (§ Stop and ask).
4. Model, provider choice or AI limits → `lpm-ai-cost.md`. Private-repository indexing or search → `lpm-code-index.md`. GitHub token facts: see `lpm-access.refs.md` § repo-credential.

### Steps
1. AI key: `get_workspace_ai_config`(workspaceId) → keep `defaultProvider`. Pre-read `list_workspace_ai_credentials`(workspaceId) → keep the provider row (`updatedAt`, `keyPreview`) or "absent". Provider is not `gemini` → say "Only Gemini runs workspace AI; this key only serves model listing." Deleting `defaultProvider` → say "AI features on <provider> stop." (gemini: "may stop; a server that runs Gemini on Vertex does not use the stored key").
2. Set or replace: say "Enter the key in LPM: Configurações → Integrações → Credenciais de IA por workspace. Tell me when it is saved." → Verify. Owner accepted the MCP path → `upsert_workspace_ai_credential`(workspaceId, provider, apiKey=<value of $ENV_NAME>, label) [O].
3. Remove: row "absent" → report "nothing stored", no call; else `delete_workspace_ai_credential`(workspaceId, provider) [O]. Leaked key → tell the owner to revoke it at the provider too.
4. GitHub token: `get_workspace_repository_credential`(workspaceId) → keep `revision`, `status`.
5. Set: `lpm workspace-github set --workspace <workspaceId> --expected-revision <revision> --token-env <ENV_NAME> --confirm`. No CLI → `upsert_workspace_repository_credential`(workspaceId, token=<value of $ENV_NAME>, expectedRevision=`revision`) [O] only after the owner accepts the MCP path. Each attempt spends 1 of 5 validations per hour; a failure goes back to the owner, no retry loop.
6. Remove: `status` `revoked` or `absent` → report "nothing stored", no call. Else `lpm workspace-github remove --workspace <workspaceId> --expected-revision <revision> --confirm`, or `delete_workspace_repository_credential`(workspaceId, expectedRevision=`revision`) [O]; then say "Revoke the token at GitHub too; LPM does not."
7. "Credential changed" → re-read step 4; your own call moved `revision` → done, no repeat.
8. Verify: run the Verify table below.

### Stop and ask
| Situation | Do / ask exactly |
|---|---|
| before `upsert_workspace_ai_credential`, `upsert_workspace_repository_credential` | "The secret will pass through this agent's context and transcript; the LPM UI (AI key) or the CLI (GitHub token) avoids that. Use the MCP call anyway?" yes → "Which env var holds the secret?" |
| before `delete_workspace_ai_credential`, `delete_workspace_repository_credential` | "<provider or GitHub> features on this workspace stop. Remove it?" |
| a secret pasted into chat | never repeat it; say "It is now in the chat history: put it in an env var and rotate it after saving." |

### Verify
| After | Re-read with | Pass when |
|---|---|---|
| AI key set, replace or delete | `list_workspace_ai_credentials`(workspaceId) | provider row present with `updatedAt` later than the pre-read (or new); absent after delete |
| AI key set, provider `openai` or `anthropic` | `list_workspace_ai_provider_models`(workspaceId, provider, operation="requirementsDocumentAnalysis") | `source == "live"` → "key works"; `unavailable` → report `unavailableReason` |
| AI key set, provider `gemini` | nothing more | report "key stored; validity not proven": a server that runs Gemini on Vertex lists models with `source == "live"` without using the stored key |
| GitHub token set or remove | `get_workspace_repository_credential`(workspaceId) | set: `status == "active"`, `revision` == old + 1, `validatedAt` set; remove: `status == "revoked"`, `revision` == old + 1 |

### Report fields
Scope, owner order (quoted), provider or GitHub, `status` / `revision` / `updatedAt` after the write (never the secret), Pending (revoke at GitHub or the provider), Next.
